comparison.objective: Align and trim a card to width using a guillotine cutter.
comparison.physical_skill: Position and hold sheet stock while operating a hinged blade with safe hand separation.
comparison.success_condition: Card cut to 8 cm within tolerance, blade left down, card flat/aligned, hands released; unsafe blade proximity fails.
comparison.reason: Tests sheet alignment, cutting, and hazard-zone discipline, not aperture passage, agitation, or retained-object sorting.
